summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] entry in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds set_window_title beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal and returning True/False; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif that calls term.set_title(title) once per control; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32), test_control_title, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Caveats: tests are unrun; the title is written unmodified, so BEL or ESC in a title will truncate the sequence (sanitizing is out of scope); the renderer uses the existing set_title method name rather than "set-title".
